# Amalgamations and financial arrangements rules ¶6-450

Different rules apply to the transfer of financial arrangements on an amalgamation depending on matters such as whether the amalgamation is a resident's restricted amalgamation, whether the borrower is solvent or insolvent, and whether the financial arrangement is between amalgamating companies or with a third party (¶20-109–¶20-111).
